user.title: Set up Map Fusion
user.description: Map Fusion combines your robot vacuum maps into one floor map tied to your Home Assistant areas.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Map Fusion is already set up.

map_data_disabled.title: Turn on the Dreame Map data camera for exact room shapes
map_data_disabled.description: Map Fusion is using room boxes for {vacuum}, so rooms can overlap. In Settings → Entities, show disabled entities, find this vacuum's "Map data" camera and enable it. Map Fusion then traces the real room outlines.

menu_options.place_area: Place an area on the map

place_area.title: Place an area
place_area.description:
Pick the area to place. Use this for areas no vacuum room covers, or to replace a vacuum room's shape.

**Easier:** the [Map Fusion page](/map-fusion) in the sidebar lets you drag and resize areas on the map.

{map}

*{frame}. Grid lines are 1 m apart.*

place_rect.title: Area rectangle
place_rect.description:
Position and size in metres on {frame}: x goes right and y goes down; read them off the grid. Orange is where the area goes with the numbers below; a dashed blue outline is its current shape.

{map}

clear_area.title: Remove a placed area
clear_area.description: The area goes back to its vacuum room, if it has one. Otherwise it becomes unplaced.

map_floor.title: Vacuum map floor
map_floor.description: By default a map goes on the floor most of its areas are on, or gets its own map when they have no floor.

filled_shapes.title: Filled room shapes
filled_shapes.description: Map Fusion also makes a "filled" version of each room: gaps the vacuum can't reach (beds, wardrobes, islands) are filled in, without growing into other rooms or past the room's bounding box. Gaps up to this size are filled. Bigger ones, like a real L-shaped room's missing corner, are left. 0 turns filling off.

abort.not_loaded: Map Fusion isn't running. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.no_frames: There's no map to place areas on yet. Link a vacuum's rooms to areas, or create a floor.
abort.no_placements: No areas have been placed by hand.

set_area.name: Set area shape
set_area.description: Place an area on a map by hand, as a rectangle (x, y, width, height) or as polygons. Replaces any vacuum room shape for that area.

frame_id.name: Map
frame_id.description: Frame id from map_fusion/get. Optional when there is only one map, or the area's floor has one.

y.name: y
y.description: Top edge in metres (y goes down).

polygons.name: Polygons
polygons.description: Instead of a rectangle: a list of rings, each a list of [x, y] points in metres.

clear_area.name: Clear area shape
clear_area.description: Remove an area's hand placement. It goes back to its vacuum room, if any.

frame_id.name: Map
frame_id.description: Frame id. Optional when the area is placed in only one map.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Return the fused map document (all frames, or one).

frame_id.name: Map
frame_id.description: Frame id from map_fusion/get. Optional when there is only one map.

variant.name: Shapes
variant.description: traced: what the vacuum mapped. filled: furniture gaps filled in.

transform_point.name: Transform point
transform_point.description: Convert a point between map metres and a vacuum's own coordinates (Dreame: mm, y up). Use it to send a vacuum to a spot picked on the map.

frame_id.name: Map
frame_id.description: Frame id from map_fusion/get. Optional when there is only one map.

source_id.name: Vacuum
source_id.description: Vacuum whose coordinates to use. Optional when the map has one vacuum.

x.name: x
x.description: x of the point (metres on the map, or vacuum units when converting to the map).

to.name: Convert to
to.description: source: map metres → vacuum coordinates. frame: vacuum coordinates → map metres.

locate_point.name: Locate point
locate_point.description: Find which area a point is in. Every card and automation gets the same answer.

frame_id.name: Map
frame_id.description: Frame id from map_fusion/get. Optional when there is only one map.

source_id.name: Vacuum
source_id.description: If set, x and y are in this vacuum's own coordinates (e.g. the robot's position).

x.name: x
x.description: x in map metres (or vacuum units with Vacuum set).

y.name: y
y.description: y in map metres (or vacuum units with Vacuum set).

variant.name: Shapes
variant.description: traced: what the vacuum mapped. filled: furniture gaps filled in.
